title: Usage insights: route detail API (model breakdown + WoW deltas) + caching + response validation
author: Jada Williams
release_notes: Adds the route detail endpoint backing Console Usage Insights: per-route time series, model breakdown, and change vs prior period; includes response schema validation and short TTL caching to keep p95 under budget.
body:
Summary: This PR implements the Usage Insights Route Detail API used by the Console route detail view. The endpoint returns (1) total cost + token attribution for the selected route, (2) breakdown by model variant (including fallback/routed-to model), and (3) deltas vs the prior period ("what changed") for spend and key performance metrics. It also adds short-lived caching and response schema validation to prevent regressions as we evolve the aggregation schema.

Motivation: The top-routes list endpoint (PR #15455) answers "what is costing the most?" but customers need to drill into a single route to understand which models are driving spend and whether the route changed week-over-week. This endpoint is the backend contract for the route detail page (ENG-8427).

API: GET /v1/analytics/usage-insights/routes/{route}/detail
Query params: start, end, compare=previous_period|none (default previous_period), granularity=hour|day, environment, region, deployment_mode, limit_models (default 10), include_unknown_model (default true)
Auth/RBAC: uses existing analytics scope checks (org/project scoping) and requires the caller to have analytics:read for the project.

Response payload (high-level): route, window, compare_window, totals {cost_usd,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,gpu_time_ms?}, timeseries[{ts,cost_usd,p50_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,error_rate}], models[{model,model_family?,cost_usd,share,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,p50_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,error_rate}], deltas {cost_usd_delta,cost_usd_pct,input_tokens_delta,output_tokens_delta,p95_latency_ms_delta,error_rate_delta}

Implementation notes: - Reads from the new hourly/daily aggregate tables introduced in PR #15441; chooses the lowest-cost query path based on granularity and time range. - Model breakdown uses top-N by cost with an "other" bucket when limit_models is exceeded (keeps response size bounded). - Delta computation is done server-side: compare window is computed as (end-start) immediately preceding the selected window; the API returns both raw values and pct deltas with safe divide handling (0-baseline -> null pct). - Caching: Adds an optional Redis-backed cache for the full response keyed by org_id/project_id/route/start/end/granularity/filters/limit_models. TTL defaults to 120s and is disabled automatically if compare=none is requested with granularity=hour and end is within the last 10 minutes (avoid caching rapidly changing windows). Cache is also bypassed when request includes debug=true (internal only). - Response validation: Adds a JSON schema (internal) for the route detail response and validates before returning. This is primarily to catch mismatches between aggregation code and the API contract (we saw this in SUP-18433 where model columns were unexpectedly missing). Validation failures return 500 with a redacted error and emit a metric usage_insights.response_validation_failed.

Performance / query budgets: - Enforced max time range: 31 days for hour granularity; 180 days for day granularity. - Enforced hard limit on timeseries points: 1100. - Adds a query cost guard in the DAL layer (max scanned partitions + max rows) and logs the computed plan in debug mode.

Testing: - Unit tests for compare-window math and delta computation edge cases. - Integration tests against a seeded dataset for: top-N models + other bucket, unknown model inclusion, and correctness of p95 latency aggregation. - Contract tests validate that the response schema matches the documented API types used by Console.

Docs/notes: - The endpoint name and response are aligned with the draft contract in the platform engineering doc and the Confluence API addendum; follow-up will be to update the docs PR once the final naming is locked. - Related: ENG-8423 (route list endpoint), ENG-8425 (export jobs), ENG-8428 (additional RBAC hardening + audit).

Screenshots: N/A (backend only)

Rollout plan: Ship behind feature flag usage_insights_route_detail_api. Console will call this endpoint only when the org is enabled. Cache can be disabled via config usage_insights.cache.enabled=false if we see unexpected staleness complaints during beta.

Example (trimmed): {"route":"checkout/quote","window":{"start":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-02-08T00:00:00Z"},"totals":{"cost_usd":312.44,"input_tokens":1882342,"output_tokens":542991,"cached_input_tokens":422130},"models":[{"model":"llama-3.1-70b-instruct","cost_usd":208.10,"share":0.666}, {"model":"llama-3.1-70b-instruct-fp8","cost_usd":71.02,"share":0.227}, {"model":"other","cost_usd":33.32,"share":0.107}],"deltas":{"cost_usd_delta":54.83,"cost_usd_pct":0.212}}

Follow-ups: - Add ETag support to reduce bandwidth (not required for initial beta). - Consider caching subcomponents (models vs timeseries) independently if we see cache churn for large windows.

Refs: Linear ENG-8424, Console route detail design spec (DES-211), support issue SUP-18433.
commits: analytics: add route detail DAL queries for hourly/daily aggregates
api: implement GET /usage-insights/routes/{route}/detail handler + filter parsing
api: add compare-window delta computation + other bucket logic
perf: add redis cache wrapper + cache key normalization
safety: add response schema + runtime validation + metrics
tests: add integration tests for model breakdown/deltas
chore: update openapi types used by console backend client
review_conversation:
Chloe Martin (review): Endpoint shape looks good. Two concerns: (1) compare-window math needs to handle DST boundaries and (2) we should not cache when end is within the last few minutes because the dashboard is near-real-time. Also please confirm we’re not leaking cross-project data in cache keys.

Jada Williams (author): Good call. Compare math is done in UTC on instants; no timezone conversions, so DST shouldn’t apply. I added tests for boundary conditions and clarified in code comments. Updated caching logic: bypass cache when end < now-10m for hour granularity. Cache key includes org_id + project_id + route + all filters; also added a unit test that changing project_id yields a different key.

Nadia Rahman (review): For model breakdown, can we ensure "unknown model" is counted rather than dropped? We saw missing rows when the model dimension isn’t populated. Also, for pct delta when baseline=0, prefer null over Infinity.

Jada Williams (author): Added include_unknown_model (default true) which forces an explicit bucket for null/empty model. pct delta now returns null when prior=0.

Allison Grant (review): Please add metrics for cache hit rate and validation failures, and ensure we don’t log full route strings if they can contain customer identifiers (even though they shouldn’t).

Jada Williams (author): Added metrics usage_insights.cache_hit/cache_miss and usage_insights.response_validation_failed. Logs now hash the route in debug logs; raw route is only present in request context and response.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): RBAC check is currently the same as route list; that’s fine, but we should ensure org/project scope is enforced before hitting cache. Otherwise a timing issue could leak cached data.

Jada Williams (author): Moved RBAC/tenant scope enforcement ahead of cache lookup and included org_id/project_id in the cache namespace. Added regression test.

Chloe Martin (approval): Approved. Please squash when merging.

Merge: Squash merged by Jada Williams into main on 2026-02-22.
